notes.title: UPDATE #6 & 70% OFF
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/f804027cd8e2b4f9de580356febabefcd9f13cc6.gif[/img]

[h1]Visceral Cubes 1.2.0 is now online.[/h1]

Hello.

Here we bring you an update on which we fix a couple small bugs and make some preparations for the next dlc (which is free).

In "EXTRACTION" we'll play as a soldier that, along his team, arrives at the facility to secure the Vial and burn the place to the ground. Armed with proper weapons, our new protagonist will face evolved visceral guys with ranged attacks. We hope you enjoy this action oriented campaign.

Now, into the content of this update.

[h1]Fixes and Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Invert Y Axis.[/b] The mouse Y axis can now be inverted at the options menu.
[*][b]Collision Fixes.[/b] Fixed a couple areas in the map where collision was glitchy.
[*][b]DLC Menu Tweaks.[/b] Added coming soon buttons for the upcoming DLC.
[*][b]FullScreen Fix.[/b] Fixed a bug where the fullscreen setting was not being saved.
[*][b]Performance Improvements.[/b] A few areas will have improved framerate.
[*][b]Rear Cam.[/b] The rear cam was disabled on the last dlc.  
[*][b]Skins Fix.[/b] Fixed a bug where the enemy skins were not being randomized on the dlc.
[*][b]Chase Music Fix.[/b] Fixed a bug where the chase music kept playing after all enemies died.
[*][b]Enemy Detection.[/b] The enemy "senses" have been slightly re-adjusted.
[*][b]Distorted SFX fix.[/b] Fixed a random bug where the splatter sound was being distorted.
[*][b]DLC Preparations.[/b] Small adjustments on the game code in preparation for the next two dlc.

As always thanks for playing, Look forward to the next dlc :)

notes.title: Distress Call Campaign is now available! [FREE]
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

Distress call is here. In the end, we put this small adventure within the main game build, so just update the game and head to the download content section in the main menu to play. Enjoy...

More agressive gameplay....
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/f804027cd8e2b4f9de580356febabefcd9f13cc6.gif[/img]

And sneakier visceral guys
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/191b711c06f872a16fe6f50fc26334f7410b39c0.gif[/img]

Don't forget to resuply your ammo and heal up at the stockpiles!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/6c4ec90f2dc8388fbbb11873ed45fc7ab062d544.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy playing. Don't forget to leave a review if you liked the game. 

[h1]DISTRESS CALL STORY[/h1]
After our protagonist obtained the vial and locked himself at facility entrance, the informant now goes into a quest to call for extraction. With the facility damaged even further, more visceral guys are now rampant. It is not time to hide but to open a path tru their guts.
----------------------------------------

We are working on an update to address a couple bugs as well as some requests from the forum. We hope you are enjoying the holidays and as always, thanks for playing ... 

Oh yeah sorry for the delay! :)

notes.title: SUMMER SALE 66% OFF! & UPDATE #4
notes.content:
[h1]Visceral Cubes 1.1.11 is now online! [/h1]

Hello Everyone

We hope you are enjoying summer sale. Visceral Cubes will be 66% off during the sale and for players that have already finished the game, there are a couple new things that you may want to check out.

[h1]New Stuff and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]FlareGun.[/b] This new weapon can be used to shoot your enemies resulting in... an explosion of course. Be careful using it at close range, remember that enemies exploding close to you can kill you. Also the flare needs some momentum before it can make the enemies explode. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/485ce76dab66fbebf077d898d73bbcf6d1704b6d.gif[/img]

[*][b]Incendiary Grenade.[/b] It has a shorter range than the flare gun, however it can be used to block certain areas. For example, a door or a bridge. Enemies touching the flames will explode. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/7b404ea9d689b257d64c107bc972bf84b3e19882.gif[/img]

[*][b]Sound Detection Range.[/b] When pressing C, you'll be able to see how far the enemies can hear you. Very useful to sneak around. Keep in mind that while you are not crouching with C, the enemies have a larger detection range. Also, if you get in front of their sigh they will still see you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/8315c3aede67199a8bab0c989d481959b6af35bb.gif[/img]

[*][b]More Enemy Animations.[/b] There are now several running and walking for the enemies. Ones may run towards you, others may crawl etc 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/b7cfaa623db1e5294372430700b7c0bc9ef8ce58.gif[/img]

[*][b]Several Bug Fixes.[/b] Most notably, the bug were the game could be save during the game over screen.

[*][b]New pickups.[/b] Flares and incendiary grenades have been places around the map.

[*][b]Small Level Design Changes.[/b]


[/list]

[h1]Incoming New stuff and fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] First DLC
[*] More bug fixes

[/list]

[h1]Word from the devs[/h1]
We hope you all enjoy the Steam Summer Sale and that you get enough games for this life and the next!

As always thank you for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #2 - Hard Difficulty Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Visceral Cubes 1.1.10 is now online! [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/9742a63d1fb52a7d37df14d8d37c98299b777dd0.gif[/img]

[h1]Hard difficulty now available![/h1]
You can now play the game on hard difficulty, which will increase the number of enemies, speed and area of detection. We encourage you to use stealth by moving while crouching and [b]look for the new medkit pickups so you can take more explosions[/b]. In this mode, a new section of the station is also available.

[h1]Other fixes and new Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Rear Cam.[/b] When the player is being chased, a rear cam will now be activated to help the player keep better track of the enemies. The rear cam can be deactivated via the pause menu.

[*][b] Medkit Pickup.[/b] A new pickup is now scattered on the station, it will raise your health up to 300 HP. This will enable you to survive one direct explosion for 150 DMG. But you won't survive another one. 

[*][b] More Documents.[/b] New leftover docs will give a bit more context to the game world a well as well as serve as hints for the "tasks" in the new section of the station.

[*][b] Performance Improvements.[/b] The frame rate should be higher at certain areas, specially at the lab.

[*][b] Difficulty Balancing.[/b] Depending on which difficulty you choose to play on, the enemies will be faster and their detection ratio larger.

[*][b] Crouching Improvements.[/b] Moving while crouching will now reduce the chances of being detected. If you plan to get near an enemy, crouch... careful, if you are close enough, you'll get detected as soon as you stand up.

[*][b] Pickup sounds.[/b] Wherever you pick a medkit, key or toy, you will now hear a sound.

[*][b] Timescale Bug Fix.[/b] A rare bug where the game froze after reloading the scene was fixed.

[*][b] AI Path-finding refinements.[/b] The AI is now more accurate at the time of chasing the player. The enemies are harder to shake off. 

[*][b] New Doc Container.[/b] A new blue container has been implemented, the old black one didn't look well in certain dark areas.


[/list]

[h1]Incoming New stuff and fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] First DLC
[*] Speed Run Mode
[*] More bug fixes

[/list]

[h1]Word from the devs[/h1]
We are looking for ways to show the detection ratio of the enemies to further improve the gameplay. 

Also, we want to apologize for the long time it took us to update the game with this new content, from time to time we get a streak of bad luck, in this case it was in the form of some power outages that damaged some of the equipment used to develop/test our games.

We will be running a giveaway soon as compensation. Join [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ominousgaminggroup] our group [/url]  so you don't miss it! 

Don't forget to drop us a review to help the new content going.

As always thank you for your support!

Thanks!

notes.title: Visceral Cubes is now available! 40% off
notes.content:
[h1]Visceral Cubes 1.0 is now online! [/h1]

Visceral Cubes is now available, grab it while the launch discount lasts!
Don't hesitate to post about any bug you find. We will still be working on balancing the game difficulty, such things as the sigh range, speed and awareness of the enemies may change in the upcoming days. For now, we just recommend you to avoid getting too close to the enemies and run if you are spotted. We hope to also add new features to the core mechanics hoping to increase the enjoyment of the game and the upcoming DLC.

[h1]Incoming New stuff and fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [strike]Elevator bug fix.[/strike]
[*] First DLC
[*] Difficulty related changes.
[*] Better pathfinding for the enemies.
[*] Performance Improvements
[/list]
[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]
[list]
[*]As always we will fix any bug you post in the bugs thread, fill it to your heart content.
[*]We are experimenting with a rear camera hoping to give the player more awareness of how is he being chased.
[/list]

And as always, thanks for your support!
